findings.title: Sender / reply-to domain mismatch
findings.explanation: Replies go to a different full domain. Legitimate support services can do this.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the reply destination through a known contact channel.

findings.title: Displayed link differs from destination
findings.explanation: The visible hostname does not match the actual link host.
findings.recommendation: Review the destination as text; do not open the link to verify it.

summary: Review the evidence and context before deciding the next triage action.
limitations: Heuristic triage priority, not a phishing probability or safe/unsafe verdict.
Authentication headers are unverified and may be forged. No DNS or cryptographic checks are performed.
No link visits, reputation checks, attachment execution, archive extraction, or malware scanning.
Full-hostname comparison can flag legitimate service domains and subdomains.
Input and runtime limits are enforced, but the parsing subprocess is not a hard RAM sandbox.
